review:
The Platinum step-up from Hot Slot: Gold Coins. Same recipe of retro Hot Slot reels plus the Coins bonus, but the Grand Jackpot jumps to 2,500x and volatility rises to high.

Cash Infinity symbols stick to the reels and push you towards Hold the Jackpot, and the Hot Slot symbols are there to keep base-game wins ticking over. Chance Level multiplies your bet in exchange for better bonus odds. 96.15% RTP. Think of it as the bigger-risk, bigger-ceiling version of Gold Coins: longer waits, but a much higher top prize when the bonus fills up.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
